#en:
Okay, I think I've got it!

Every time I hit that first button, one of three patterns lights up. I'm pretty sure it's setting the pattern the other three are supposed to match.

So I press that, then find the matching buttons on the other panels. Easy.
Oh, and I've only got ten seconds to do it...

Here goes nothing...
zh:
好了，我想我搞明白了！

每次我按下第一个按钮，三个图案中就会亮起一个。我基本可以确定，它是在设定另外三个需要匹配的图案。

所以我按下那个按钮，然后在其他面板上找到匹配的按钮。简单。
哦，而且我只有十秒钟来完成……

管他呢，上吧……
